cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Choose the overseas job or our shared shop. Then we'll know what 'we'll build something' meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Yes. This choice gives the old sentence its ending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking whether your promise has room for the shop without you.

mechanism: A professionally narrows the shop/job options so B's present decision assigns a meaning to an earlier shared promise.
confusable: D202 chooses priorities now; D226 makes that choice reinterpret a past agreement.
comparison: Livelihood partnership and a foreign job differ from ongoing home access.
seedUse: Keep the prior promise and B's timing objection but make the choice actionable, not an old-sentence metaphor.
